messages.subject: Re: stan manual suggestion
parts:
I added a 'vectorizing the model' section to the intro.

I also called out explicit vs. implicit priors a bit more
cleanly.

Daniel's working on getting JAGS set up to do testing.
We want to test JAGS implementations of the BUGS models
versus

-- Stan with basic translation, simple vectorization,
and where appropriate reparameterization

-- Stan with NUTS samplers with diagonal adaptation and
with the full mass matri

We can also compare basic and adaptive Metropolis once
Peter has it implemented. And of course, RM-HMC once
Michael implements it in Stan.

- Bob
